description:
A/O Bicycle Co. is committed to serving the biking needs of women everywhere. For women that understand that riding is a lifestyle. For women that understand that riding for function and fun are the same. And for women that understand that healthy living is joyful living.

Our bikes are carefully designed to meet your unique needs— everything from your body type to the roads you’ll ride.

From purchase to pedal, we’re with you every step of the way. We’ll invite you to participate in the process. We’ll ask questions and we’ll listen. We’ll find out where you want to go and what you consider comfortable. Because getting to know you is how we get it right.

WEB REFERRAL AGREEMENT

This agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Experience Architects (“A/O Women's Bicycles” or “us”) and you or the entity you represent (“Referral Affiliate” or “you”), and contains the terms and conditions governing the relationship, under which Referral Affiliate will refer potential Buyers to the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site, and A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. will provide Referral Affiliate a commission on any purchases made by the referred Buyer. The Agreement will be effective for all purposes upon the earlier of: (a) when you click the “I Accept” button; or (b) when you begin reselling any A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. products or service. You, Referral Affiliate, represent to us that you are lawfully able to enter into contracts, and that if you are entering into this Agreement on behalf of your employer, you have the legal authority to bind that entity.

  1. 1. 1. Definitions. For the purposes of this Agreement, the following terms have the following meanings:



    1. 1. 1.1 "Buyer" means an individual or entity who purchases a A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Product on the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site using the Affiliate Promotional Code.



    1. 2. 1.2 "A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site" means A/O Women’s Bicycle Co.’ web site where the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Product is available for purchase. This includes www.A/O Women’s Bicycle Co..com only. 



    1. 3. 1.3 "Affiliate Promotional Codes" means the code that has been assigned to Referral Affiliate by A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. for use in Referral Affiliates’ promotional activities. 



    1. 4. 1.4 "Referral Affiliate Web Page" means a web page that contains an advertisement which, when clicked, redirects to the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site.



    1. 5. 1.5 "A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Product" means A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. any products sold by A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. through the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site products.



    1. 6. 1.6 "Net Sales" means the total amounts actually received by A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. for A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Products sold through the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site by users entering the Affiliate Promotional Code in the “Discount Code” box of the checkout page; less commissions, taxes paid by customers, withholding taxes, discounts, bad debts and other write-offs, a reserve for returns, and currency exchange fees, if any.



    1. 7. 1.7 "Trademark" means the logo attached in Exhibit A. 



    1. 8. 2. Appointment. 

 

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. hereby appoints Referral Affiliate as its non-exclusive sales agent to refer Buyers as described hereunder. Referral Affiliate understands that Referral Affiliate does not have authority to make or accept any offers, or make any representations on behalf of A/O Women’s Bicycle Co.. Referral Affiliate will place advertisement links on Referral Affiliate Web Pages that direct prospective Buyers to the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site, or distribute e-mails with a link to prospective Buyers that directs them to the A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Web Site. Web Site using Referral Affiliate’s links. All affiliates and not permitted to use any discount codes to aid in the conversion of the referral. Any unauthorized discount used affiliate through coupon websites and the likewise will be disqualified and denied payment. 



    1. 1. 4. Commissions. 



No sooner that 60 days after the referral purchase has been made, A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. will pay you a commission based on the Net Sales received by A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. during such calendar quarter, as shown on the page where you registered as a Referral Affiliate. In the event that a successful chargeback occurs after commission on the corresponding original transaction has been paid, A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. is entitled to withhold an amount equal to the commission on the returned transaction from a subsequent payment to Referral Affiliate.

Any sales attributed to the use of an unauthorized discount code or referral from 3rd party websites, such as discount coupon websites will not be counted or paid to the affiliate. Only A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. approved discount codes given to affiliate's accounts will be approved. All affiliates and not permitted to use any discount codes to aid in the conversion of the referral. Any unauthorized discount used affiliate through coupon websites and the likewise will be disqualified and denied payment.

A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. will audit and affiliate payment reports and assess the legitimacy of the attributed sale to affiliate's account. A/O Women’s Bicycle Co. Enterprise will provide reporting and any payment adjustment criteria upon request.

    1. 1. 9. Term and Termination
